messages:
maya: Quick heads-up  the new sample-app Dockerfile and compose use REDWOOD_API_KEY, but our SDKs/apps prefer RW_API_KEY. New hires often paste REDWOOD_API_KEY into env and hit 401s after an org key rotation.
liam: Is that from compose overriding local envs?
sam: Yeah. Locally people export RW_API_KEY, but compose supplies REDWOOD_API_KEY into the container, so both keys end up present. Our SDK precedence is RW_API_KEY > REDWOOD_API_KEY > ~/.redwood/credentials which causes confusion.
manika: Can you paste the compose snippet?
maya: Sure:
```yaml
services:
  web:
    environment:
      - REDWOOD_API_KEY=${REDWOOD_API_KEY}
```
maya: So the container gets the stale REDWOOD_API_KEY and fails post-rotation.
liam: Does SDK retry behavior make this noisy? e.g., silent retries on 401?
sam: SDK retries twice with exponential backoff then surfaces error. But some integrations swallow errors and keep retrying, making it look like transient failures.
anika: Proposed quick fixes: (1) change sample apps to only use RW_API_KEY, (2) add entrypoint startup check that warns if both envs present, (3) add SDK startup log WARN on repeated 401s.
maya: Quick win = change compose to read RW_API_KEY and add a tiny entrypoint that prints: "WARNING: Both REDWOOD_API_KEY and RW_API_KEY set 5 using RW_API_KEY. Remove REDWOOD_API_KEY to avoid stale tokens. See docs: https://redwood.example/docs/auth."
liam: Longer term SDK idea: expose SDK_CRED_PRIORITY env like "RW,REDWOOD,FILE" so infra teams can control precedence.
sre-bot: Incident note: multiple support tickets last week referenced 401s due to stale env in containers. Tickets: #4521 #4527.
sam: Also suggest small CLI parity tool `rw auth inspect` (node/python/go) that prints which source would be used. Example:
```
Source: env(RW_API_KEY)
Value: set (redacted)
Config file: ~/.redwood/credentials - not present
```
manika: Agree, helps onboarding. Keep it minimal and scriptable.
maya: I'll open a PR to update compose and add the entrypoint check. @liam can you create follow-up issues for SDK_CRED_PRIORITY and rw auth inspect across SDKs?
liam: On it, will link PR and ticket.
maya: Thanks, hoping this reduces onboarding friction and support noise.
